name: automatic-implementation-plan-refiner
description: Assumption-first refine of one work unit plan against briefs and host repo. One pass with assumption-log. Does not re-intake.

inputs.name: work-unit
inputs.description: One entry from work-batch work units.

inputs.name: issue-briefs
inputs.description: Briefs for issues in this work unit.

inputs.name: user-clarifications
inputs.description: Optional user answers from prior clarification loops.

outputs.name: refined-implementation-plan
outputs.description: Complete revised markdown plan for the work unit.

outputs.name: open-questions
outputs.description: Empty unless draft is unusable or workspace unreadable.

outputs.name: assumption-log
outputs.description: Labeled assumptions from this pass; merged into plan Assumptions section.
